inputs.original_proposal: Review: coalesced signal updates with LiveView Page v0.3.0 phase 2

blockers: DATA RACE on m_currentFrameCount in onFrame (line ~158 of qttunebridge.cpp): worker thread reads m_currentFrameCount without synchronization while handleFrameInternal (GUI thread) writes it. Variable is non-atomic int accessed from multiple threads.

LOST SIGNAL MODEL FUNCTIONALITY: SignalListModel completely removed but LiveViewPage.qml referenced QtTune.signalModel and QtTune.toggleSubscribed which no longer exist. This breaks the QML binding contract even though LiveViewPage is deleted - the removed C++ code still needs to be consistent.
questions: Why remove SignalListModel and signal batching entirely? The 'coalesced signal updates' feature appears to be removed rather than refactored. What is the intended replacement for signal value streaming?
The test StreamingContinuesPastTenThousandFrames test was removed but relied on forceFrameCountForTesting which is also being removed. How should the backpressure behavior be tested now?
Is the data race on m_currentFrameCount intentional? The old code used atomic m_inFlightFrames for thread-safe backpressure tracking.
nits: Comment 'frame is stack-owned by mock_worker' in onFrame is misleading - the frame is passed by pointer from the worker thread, not stack-owned by mock_worker.
Missing newline at end of test file (diff shows '\\ No newline at end of file').
